title: Show Custom Dialog inside Loop
description: Error-prone / UX rule — Show Custom Dialog inside a Loop pops a modal on every iteration, trapping the user in repeated prompts.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A modal dialog per iteration blocks the script and overwhelms the user.
rule.remediation: Collect the outcome and show one summary dialog after the loop.
